arguments.text: Strong start. Settle now, long race, ease into race rhythm.

6000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000, last 1000 m out). Target: near-even shaft power about 190-200 W (pod CP 189, 18 kJ reserve; may be 10-25 pct off), a touch harder into the current, a touch easier with it. Check CP with heart rate: at steady effort below CP HR levels off, above it keeps climbing. Watch for weed (speed drops at same pod power -> clear_rudder test), pod drift (pod power changes but HR and GPS speed do not), radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell). Final push: spend leftover reserve from about 600-800 m out, finish cue at about 400 m.

Speed_loss watch threshold -0.2 was too coarse (drop was ~-0.12).

arguments.text: 6000 m, legs 1250 m out-and-back: turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000 m, last leg 1000 m (with current, push +0.25 out / -0.25 back). Plan: pod ~205-208 W on with-current legs (ground pace ~143), ~215 W into current (ground ~164), set by a pace target right after each turn (targets persist through turns, so re-cue each leg). Spend remaining reserve from ~700 m out; finish cue ~350-400 m. Keep watching for weed again (speed_loss watch), pod drift (pod vs HR/GPS), radio course changes.

Pod 30-s mean rose 206->213 from ~1040 but GPS speed flat 3.47 and push_local fell 0.25->0.20: either pod starting to read high (drift) or lag. Trust GPS pace + HR over pod watts until clear. arguments.text: t=1125 s: pod rose 207->231 W from ~1040 s but GPS speed flat 3.46 (to 1100 s) and HR only +2.4 bpm (176->178.4, same creep as before); rate 62 unchanged; paddler 8/10, feels good, no heaviness. Suspect pod reading high (gain drift) or a wind/current shift; weed less likely (no heavy feel). Test after turn 3: if push_local on the back leg is also ~0.15 below -0.25 -> pod drift or drag; if it is better than -0.25 -> wind shift. Use GPS pace and boat-model reserve, not pod watts. Into-current target ~160 s/500 (boat-model sustainable ~153 W), sprint last ~350 m.
